notActivated.title: Activate a License for This Product
notActivated.description: No license is activated for this product yet. Until you activate one, devices can't get a seat from the licensing server.

gracePeriodOver.title: The Licensing Server Needs to Sync
gracePeriodOver.description: The licensing server hasn't synced over the internet for longer than this license allows, so devices can't get a seat. Connect it to the internet and select Sync.

expired.title: This Product's License Has Expired
expired.description: The license for this product has expired, so devices can't get a seat from the licensing server. Ask your software vendor to renew the license. Then select Sync, or activate again if the server has no internet access.

suspended.title: This Product's License Is Suspended
suspended.description: The license for this product is suspended, so devices can't get a seat from the licensing server. Contact your software vendor.

disabled.title: This Product Is Disabled
disabled.description: The licensing server doesn't serve this product, so devices can't get a seat for it. To enable the product, edit the server's config and restart the server.

activateDialog.title: Activate License
activateDialog.description: Activate the licensing server so it can lease seats for this product.

error.invalidLicenseKey: This license key isn't valid. Check it and try again.
error.networkError: The licensing server couldn't connect to the internet. Check its connection, or activate offline instead.

error.keyMismatch: This doesn't match the license key this product is activated with.
